Congratulations on completing this journey! Job well done!

We hope you've enjoyed traveling with us as you:

- Navigated to Dashboards and browsed a dashboard with multiple panels
- Opened Explore and saw the query editor interface
- Visited a Drilldown app and saw queryless data exploration

---

### More to explore (optional)

The world is your oyster! Read more about how you can:

- [Build dashboards](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana-cloud/visualizations/dashboards/build-dashboards/)
- [Get started with Explore](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana-cloud/visualizations/explore/get-started-with-explore/)
- [Explore data using Metrics Drilldown](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana-cloud/visualizations/simplified-exploration/metrics/)

### Related paths

Consider taking the following paths after you complete this journey:

- [Explore data using Metrics Drilldown](https://grafana.com/docs/learning-paths/drilldown-metrics/)
- [Explore logs using Logs Drilldown](https://grafana.com/docs/learning-paths/drilldown-logs/)
- [Use Traces Drilldown to identify high latency](https://grafana.com/docs/learning-paths/drilldown-traces/)
